endpoints.description: Returns API readiness plus dependency status (also mounted at /api/v1/health for client callers).

rest_exception.note: Plain GET /health for lifecycle systems, load balancers, and curl probes that cannot use a generated Connect client.

endpoints.description: Cursor-paginated event log with optional kind + since filters.
Returns counts + verdict success rate with N<5 suppression.
Cursor-paginated placement rows for a scenario.
Appends an Override row. Honors Idempotency-Key and X-Dry-Run.
Deterministically derives the operation list from resolved/validated conflicts. v0.1 returns the plan envelope; RunApply is unimplemented.
Executes the supplied plan. v0.1 surfaces CodeUnimplemented; v0.2 wires the executor.
Cursor-paginated history of apply runs (empty in v0.1).
Returns the toolchain build-green snapshot. v0.1 returns an empty baseline.
Inserts a durable `// arch:allow` marker into a source file, sanctioning a finding as intentional. Safe, non-destructive (comment-only) write.
Orchestrates graph extract (if needed), domains derivation, and conflicts detection; applies severity / type filters; returns a deterministic summary and exit code mapping.
Walks scenarios/*/.vrooli/service.json, runs Audit on each, and returns per-scenario reports plus a totals rollup. Honors include_scenarios / exclude_scenarios filters.
Runs every registered Detector against a scenario's graph snapshot + manifest, persists the resulting Conflict envelopes, and emits one analytics event per detection.
Cursor-paginated list of stored conflicts, filterable by scenario and type.
Returns the Conflict envelope for the supplied id.
Returns outstanding conflicts and a clean=true gate when zero error-severity rows remain. Used by the dogfood test.
Returns the set of Detector plug-ins compiled into this binary.
Returns the set of Resolver plug-ins compiled into this binary.

endpoints.summary: Derive the domain map for a scenario
endpoints.description: Walks the domain-extraction ladder (DOMAINS.md → api/internal folders → cli groups) and returns the canonical derived domain map with per-source provenance.
Returns the derived domain map for a scenario (re-derived per call; deterministic).
Reports where a scenario's surfaces (DOMAINS.md, api folders, cli groups, ui features) disagree on the domain set. Advisory, never a hard gate.

endpoints.summary: Extract and persist a graph snapshot
endpoints.description: Delegates to the language code-graph adapter(s), normalizes, dedupes, and persists the resulting snapshot.

endpoints.summary: Get a persisted snapshot by id
endpoints.description: Returns the canonical-form GraphSnapshot for the supplied id.
Cursor-paginated list of persisted snapshots, optionally filtered by scenario.
Removes cached snapshots for the scenario. Honors X-Dry-Run.
Returns the persisted snapshot serialized as canonical-form JSON bytes for offline analysis or fixture authoring.

endpoints.summary: Open a migration and ingest findings
endpoints.description: Opens a tracked migration for a scenario and ingests the initial ArchitectureFinding set (all start detected).
Returns the migration headers for a scenario (newest first), or every migration when scenario is empty.
Returns the migration plus every tracked finding and rollup counts.
Returns the prioritized, dependency-aware worklist of open findings (regressions first, then cycles, then severity).
Records that the agent fixed a finding by hand, with an operator note.
Records a hand-fix as a status-only transition. Auto-execution of file-op fixes stays deferred to the apply-execution plan.
Reconciles a fresh findings set against the tracked set by stable id: absent→validated, present→stay, (re)appeared→regression.
Marks the migration closed.
Runs every registered Signal on the chunk and aggregates them into a Verdict (auto_place / suggest / conflict).
Returns the same Verdict shape as ScoreChunk with full per-signal evidence so operators can inspect the placement decision.
Returns the set of Signal plug-ins, their default weights, and per-scenario manifest-overlaid weights when scenario is supplied.
Computes per-domain coupling metrics (efferent/afferent, instability, fan-out, stable-kernel) and a graded boundary-health score with advisory smells.
